maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What is the cost of this work?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
This !s the balance required for the close of the year on account of the construction of improvements hi the

liar born- of Quebec. The work is under contract to Messrs. Dussault and Lemieux.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What is the matter with the Harbour Commission ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: This is outside the work of the Harbour Commission. The Harbour Commissioners have certain funds at their disposal, but this is independent of them.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: How do you manage the work in Quebec? Is the department doing some work specially outside of the work done by the Harbour Commission ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Yes, whatever is done by the Harbour Commission has to be done out of the funds of the harbour board under the Harbour Commissioner's Act. This is a general expenditure out of the Dominion treasury.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: How do wre stand now with the Harbour Commissioners of Quebec ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: They have a balance at their disposal out of the present authorization of between .$300,000 and $400,000, and they have works in hand and contemplated which will take all of that and probably more ; but that is independent of the appropriations referred to in this item.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Where does that $300,000 or $400,000 come from ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Several years ago we consolidated the Acts respecting the harbour commission of Quebec, and any funds previously authorized which were not expended were carried into the new Act. There was a balance, if my memory serves me rightly, of $300,000 or $400,000. The Harbour Commissioners are undertaking works which will take all of that sum and probably more.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: How much do they owe the country now ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: A very large sum ; I cannot give it off-hand. A few years ago they issued bonds which have a certain priority over the government debt. There is a considerable debt, but it does not touch this item at all.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: No, but it touches the treasury of the country.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: A good many harbours touch the treasury of the country.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I think that is the worst.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Quebec is a very important harbour, and we must provide for Its development.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Would it not be a good plan to abolish all these harbour commissions and have the harbours all put under the control of the Department of Public Works?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: That is a large question as to which I cannot give my hon. friend an answer to-night.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I see it stated in the newspapers that something is going to be done in that way in Montreal-that the harbour commission is going to be changed and the harbour put under the management of the Department of Marine and Fisheries. I do not know whether or not the newspapers are correct; but if that is done in Montreal, why should it not be done in Quebec and everywhere else?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: It is not yet done in Montreal, and if we wait until it is proposed there my hon. friend's question will be much more in order. It is not connected with this vote.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: This vote of $50,000 is not to be spent by the harbour commissioners, but it is all public money, and I think it would be a very good thing if all these moneys which are now spent by commissioners were spent by a minister directly responsible to parliament.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I would like to ask the minister whether the government intend to do anything in the port of Quebec to repair the wall which fell down last spring ? About 600 feet of the cross wall tumbled into the basin, and last week I was told that nothing had been done yet. A gentleman who was here from Quebec requested me to ask the government what they proposed to do. He said the present condition was a great injury to the trade of Quebec ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: That is a portion of the work which comes under the control of the harbour commissioners. I had an interview several days ago with gentlemen representing the harbour commissioners, who pointed out the necessity of the repairs to which my hon. friend has referred. It is contemplated that these repairs will be made as far as possible out of the funds which remain unexpended by the harbour commissioners. I think the carrying out of the work which the harbour commissioners desire to do will cost a considerable sum in excess of what is available in their hands ; but they are having plans made, and I understand that they will undertake very soon the repairs to which my hon. friend refers.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Where Is this $50,000 to be spent ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: This is for the extension of what is known as the Quebec breakwater extending from the Louise embankment. That is under contract, and this is to pay the balance due to the contractors to the 30th of June.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Who are the contractors ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Dussault & Lemieux.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What is the amount of their contract ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: When was that contract let ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: And this amount is over the amount of the contract ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
No, it is the excess of what we expected would be required under their contract in the present fiscal year.
Mi* AMES. How much have they already received ail told on this contract ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The amount to the 31st of December, 1904, was $107,692.86. The deputy informs me that the amount expended since wrouId probably amount to $50,000.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: When was that contract to be finished ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: It is to be finished during the coming fiscal year.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: If they have spent $107,000 out of a contract of $437,000, they have to spend over $300,000 this year.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Yes. The work was to be finished during the present year, but it is probable that they will not be able to finish it.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Is that their fault, or what is the cause of it ? Who is supervising that work ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: An old engineer of the department stationed at Quebec named Valiquet. The work that has been done is very satisfactory. Apart from the fact that it has not gone on as rapidly as was expected, there is no complaint.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What penalties do these contractors have to pay for not finishing their contracts In time ? When he is answering that I would like to know what competition there was for the work, when let, and how many tenders were received. I am afraid the minister has not the information to-night, that we ought to have on this matter. I would like to know how many tenders were received,what each tender was and who were the tenders and if this was the lowest.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
All that I have no doubt has been before the House, but I shall gladly get it again, if my hon. friend wishes it, on the supplementary item.
Mr. URIAH "WILSON. Would the minister tell the penalty for nonfulfilment of the contract in time ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
The general penalty'is that when a contractor tenders he is obliged to put up a certain sum by way of security, Mr. FIELDING.
and if he does not go on, that will be forfeited. What else can be done ?

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
I would suggest that tenders might have penalties attached that unless the contract is fulfilled the contractor will have to pay so much a day as damages. I think this is sometimes in contracts and I think it might very reasonably be put in because I d<>
not see any reason why a man should contract to do a work and not have it done unless he can give better reasons than those generally given for not completing it in time. Apparently this contract is not half done yet.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: As respects the adoption of a new plan in dealing with contracts that is a wide matter and while glad to have the hon. member's suggestions I would not undertake to assent to his proposition tonight. The department is acting in the light of long experience, and I have no doubt the officials take every precaution open to them. It is sometimes found necessary to extend the time of contracts.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Is one-half the work done ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: According to these figures, no. Only $150,000 out of $400,000 and odd has been expended so that is less than one-half.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
That is not very
satisfactory is it ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The deputy minister informs me that the latter part of the work is apt to be done more rapidly. There is always time lost in commencing the work, in gathering plant, &c., so that although less than one-half has been done now that does not show that the work will not be completed within the time specified.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: How many tenders were there and what is the amount of each tender ? -

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The deputy, speaking from memory, says there were six tenders and this was the lowest.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Can we not have the name ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Yes, but I have not them now. I have no doubt all the information on this has already been given, but I do not say that is a reason why we should not give it again. When the main estimate was taken in all probability it was discussed as the matter has been running for several years.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Has the main estimate for this year been taken ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
No ; it would be discussed in the last year or the year before. I would suggest that as this is a contract and has to be paid, we might pass this item,

and when on the main estimates ail this information might be brought down.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Will the minister be prepared when the main estimates are voted to answer the question of the hon. member for Lennox, as to whether there are in the contract any penalties for failure to fulfil the contract within a specified time.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Certainly I shall be very glad to bring down the contract.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: There is an exploratory voyage in Hudson bay under the superintendence of the government, and a number of the men employed on the steamer which has gone there have left orders for the payment of their salary during their absence. These salaries are not being paid because the vote of last year, as I understand, has been exhausted. Have any steps been taken to pass the necessary supplementary item in order that these arrears of salary may be settled? X ask this because a number of" these men's families are in want at the present"moment and I think that the supplementary estimate is really a pressing matter.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Yes, it is included in an item which was passsed on Friday night and as soon as we complete the various votes we will have a special supply Bill to cover all these cases and to meet payments of this nature ?

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: We will allow this to pass and have the discussion on the main estimate.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
Certainly that is fair.
Harbours and rivers-Ontario, $26,000.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: We shall have to ask this item to stand.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Before it is dropped may I ask how many tenders were received for the dredging at Fort William aud Tort Arthur and who were the tenderers ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Nine tenders were received for the Port Arthur dredging.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: And the names, jilease.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Bowman, Southampton ; John H. Hickler, and Neil Macdonald, Sault Ste. Marie ; the Great Lakes Dredging Company, Limited, Port Arthur ; C. S. Boone, Toronto ; Wm. Davis & Sons, Ottawa, the Port Arthur Dredging & Harbour Improvement Company, Port Arthur ; Roger Miller, Ingersoll, and M. J. Haney, Toronto.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Whose tender was accepted ?

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Bowman was the most favourable.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
And the rate ?
Mi*. FIELDING. The rate was 14 cents per cubic yard of clay.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Has the minister any objection to giving the rates of the other tenderers ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The contract is not signed although it is awarded. I would prefer the hon. gentleman to renew the question several days later. The question is a proper one, but we prefer not to make this public until the contract is signed.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: And the Fort William names, please ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The tenderers are the same, with the addition of James Morphy, Lewis Walsh, and John King, Fort William.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: To whom was this one awarded, for Fort William ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: To Mr. Bowman, at 12 cents per cubic yard.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Has the contract been signed ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The contracts are being prepared in the department but have not been signed.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Has any valuation been made of the Collingwood dry dock, if so by whom and what was the amount at which it was figured for the purpose of getting the bounty ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The valuation made by Mr. Louis Coste was $540,000 or a little over.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Has a year elapsed since the official valuation was made, and what time will the bounty be payable ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: A year has not elapsed.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: When item 65 comes up again will the hon. minister lay on the table copies of the ten offers that were made, and also a copy of the specification ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: If the contract has in the meantime been executed and the transaction complete, there is no objection to bringing down all the tenders, but the practice is not to make the details public while the matter is pending. In a few days the whole transaction will be completed by the execution of the contract; and if not brought down on this estimate, we have no objection to bringing the information down on the main estimates, which are yet to be dealt with.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Was the contract given to the lowest tenderer ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
Yes, in both cases.
Public buildings in Richibucto, New Brunswick, $1,600.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
This is to pay the balance due the contractor for fittings, &c. A part of this was paid from the general appropriation temporarily and a special vote -is required to provide for the same. The



total amount of the contract for the fittings is $2,000, and the total amount expended on the building and fittings up to the 31st December, 1904, was $17,343.23. That expenditure includes, not only the building, but the electric lights, electric boxes, boiler, heating apparatus, and so forth. The contract for the building itself was $9,716.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Were tenders called for ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The heating apparatus was contracted for separately by Mr. F. Powers, of Lunenburg, and it amounted to $799. Mr. Reid, the contractor, was asked to give an offer for the fittings, and he received $2,000.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: How many tenders were offered ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: There were four for the building itself.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The building cost $9,000 and the fittings almost as much more.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: In the $17,000 is included the purchase of the site, which was bought from Phinney & Steeve, Richibucto, at $800.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What was the size of the lot ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: 230 feet by 416 feet- very nearly two acres.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Who acted for the department in making the purchase ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The department sent down an officer to examine the site and inquire from local people the value.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Is there an officer of the department who goes there in the public interest, or was it a favour to some friend of the government ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The practice is that, when this place is not at too a great a distance from Ottawa, the chief architect sends an officer from the department. But when it is deemed not neeessary to do that, they employ a local officer of the Department of Public Works. This local officer collects the opinions of these who are well informed as to the fair value of the land.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Tenders were not asked for, I imagine, until the government had bought the site, or, at least, knew what it would cost. So, they had $800 for the site and $9,000 for the contract. But there is a big difference between that and $17,000, which is the total cost.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
The hon. gentleman has forgotten what I said. The contract was not for $9,000 but for $9,800. There is nearly $1,000 accounted for. Then there were some extras on the contract. Then, there is $800 for lighting and $700 for heat-Mr. FIELDING.
ing apparatus. Then you have the fittings and so on.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: But that is still far from $17,000.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I suppose the minister has before him the items making up the total ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I think I ought to have, but I am sorry to say I have not. If any hon. gentleman would rather have the details, I am quite willing that the item should stand over until the statement is prepared.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I think it would be better.

speakerposition: Deputy Speaker and Chair of Committees of the Whole of the House of Commons
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
The item stands.
Public Works-chargeable to income-public buildings-Ontario, London drill hall and armoury-electric wiring and fixtures, grading sidewalks, &e., $6,000.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: There was a contract for the electric wiring amounting to $4,750 of .which the contractors have received $950, leaving a balance of $3,S00. There is due on granolithic walks $750, grading of the site $250, balance on architect's commission $376, incidentals $204 and other items up in round figures $6,000.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What has it all cost ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The total cost to March 1st, 1905, is $193,944.07.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What is the amount of the contract ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The contract was for $133,897.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What was that to. cover ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: For the building as ordinarily understood. They are extras as ' set forth in the list I have before me.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: There is a difference there of $60,000 over the original contract.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: But then the total cost includes site, fittings, kerbs, levelling and other things of that kind which are not part of the building but which must be paid for.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: But the point is this -the government comes to parliament and we are supposed to vote the money required for a building as they explain it to us. But we find afterwards that there are extras or incidentals that bring it up to a much larger figure.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
I have the items set forth here, if any hon. gentleman wishes to hear them.
Mr. TAYeOR. I understand the minister to say that this work is all completed. Why should the work be done before the money is voted ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
The chief architect says that the work is practically completed. There may be some of the outside work going on.
(Mr. BERGERON. According to the figures the minister gave there is a sum due their architect. What is that for ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: That is for the superintending architect employed to supervise the work ; that is, in lieu of the clerk of works.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: But why should the government go and build granolithic walks and all that kind of thing before the money is voted and only after the work is done, come to parliament for the money ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: As Minister of Finance I join heartily with my hon. friend in the view he expresses. But, as acting Minister of Public Works, I may have to take a different view.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What was the original estimate for this work ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The original estimate was $15,000 for the building, including, heating and lighting, and the cost has been $158,000.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: How about the contract ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: These are for outside work and also for the site which cost $27,000.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Was not a site belonging to the government used for this building ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
No, it was a new purchase.
Mr. BERGERoN. From whom ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: There were a number of lots purchased from various people.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: This is not on the site of the old building, is it ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: An entirely new site.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Wasn't there a drill hall there before ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Not on this site.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What has become of the site of the old building ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: This is erected on a separate site that had to be purchased at a cost of $27,000, including legal expenses.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What has become of the old site ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: It is still there ; I can guarantee that it has not been carried away. I do not know whether it has been sold or not. There are some old buildings on the site that have been sold.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Can the hon. gentleman bring down the information about that?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
I will.
214}	'

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Can the minister tell us what is the accommodation in this drill shed, what forces can it accommodate?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The main drill hall is 80 feet by 195. There are in connection with it eight armouries, a gun-shed, three harness rooms, several rooms for officers, band room, lecture room, room for army medical and army service corps, sergeants' mess, quartermaster's stores, bowling alley, lavatory, bathroom, room for caretaker. It is a very large and spacious place.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Is the government building a bowling alley ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: That is not an unusual thing in drill halls.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Is the government keeping it up ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
So far as the maintenance of the building is concerned, the government will keep it up. I do not know who will provide the balls.
Grosse Isle quarantine station-improvements and repairs, supplies, &c., $8,000.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: These Improvements include overhauling and renovating the steamer ' Challenger,' that is a part of the quarantine apparatus.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: We voted some time ago an amount of .money for that same purpose.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
That was in the main estimate ; this is to wind up the affairs of the current year. The expenditures at Grosse Isle are under the supervision of the Public Works Office at Quebec.
Northwest Territories-Lloydminster immigrant building (revote of lapsed amount) $2,500.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What has been done at Lloydminster ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: This building was commenced in 1903-4 by the Department of the Interior ; the total expenditure has been $20,246. This sum will finish it. The vote of last year was allowed to lapse. This building was begun by the Department of the Interior and is now finished. It is charged to public works.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Is it for immigration purposes ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Yes, and the militia building is for drill purposes; but it is charged to public works. That department is the builder for all departments.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: This building is also used for police purposes, is it not ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The department are not aware, but it would he, I presume, used for any Dominion purpose.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
They should put a fence around it and make it look a little
COMMONS [DOT]
neater. Thirty thousand dollars is altogether too much for a building of that kind, but things were done at that time with a rush.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: What material is it built of?

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
Wood.
Public Works-income-British Columbia- Dominion public buildings-improvements, renewals, repairs, &c., $3,000.

maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Do we require to have these general votes all the time ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext:
Yes.
Some resolutions reported.
Mr. FIELDING moved the adjournment of the House.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Before the adjournment will the hon. Minister of Finance state what business will be taken up to-morrow?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: The motion for supply will be made to-morrow.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: No autonomy Bill tomorrow ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I think not to-morrow.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I thought we were promised that to-day or to-morrow for certain.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: By whom?

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: When it was left over last week.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I do not know whether there has been any understanding between my right hon. friend the Prime Minister (Sir Wilfrid Laurier) and the hon. leader of the opposition (Mr. R. L. Borden), but it will be subject to what the Prime Minister may say to-morrow. He did not intimate when he went away that it would come up.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I think there was a general understanding that it would be taken up Monday or Tuesday.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: I will have to ask the hon. gentleman to reserve that question until the Prime Minister is present.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Then, it will be estimates.

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Yes, estimates.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Conservative Party (1867-1942)
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Public Works ?

speakerposition: Minister of Finance and Receiver General
maintopic: SUPPLY-PURCHASE OF MILITIA CAMP AT KENTV1LLE, N.S.
speechtext: Yes, I think so.
Motion agreed to, House adjourned at 10.50 p.m.
Tuesday, May 30, 1905.
